description: NaKSnF₆ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pna2₁ space group. K is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of K-F bond distances ranging from 2.69-2.80 Å. Na is bonded to six F atoms to form NaF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent SnF₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one SnF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-45°. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.18-2.45 Å. Sn is bonded to six F atoms to form SnF₆ octahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaF₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one NaF₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 33-45°. There are a spread of Sn-F bond distances ranging from 1.97-2.00 Å. There are six inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one K, one Na, and one Sn atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded to two equivalent K, one Na, and one Sn atom to form distorted corner-sharing FK₂NaSn tetrahedra.
